title: Korea in February: Pack Smart, Plan Seollal
summary: Korea in February shifts from deep winter toward early spring. Learn what to pack, how to plan around Seollal travel, and where to look for the first blossoms.

slides.title: February: Pack Layers
slides.voice: Korea in February swings from winter to spring. Pack layers.

slides.title: Three Cold-Weather Basics
slides.sub: Warm coat, removable layers, grippy shoes
slides.voice: Bring a warm coat, removable layers, and grippy shoes. Early February and mountain days stay cold.
slides.photo_query: winter coat layers grippy shoes Korea

slides.title: Book Intercity Trips Early
slides.sub: Trains and buses sell out weeks ahead
slides.voice: Around Seollal, trains and buses between cities sell out weeks ahead. Book early or stay put on the busiest days.

slides.title: Look For Jeju Blossoms
slides.voice: Late February can bring the first plum blossoms around Seogwipo. Jeju feels springlike while Seoul can still need winter coats.
